title: IsoEnergy Increases Strategic Holding in Premier American Uranium Inc.
summary: IsoEnergy Ltd. is a well-funded uranium exploration and development company with a portfolio of prospective projects that sit in the Athabasca Basin in Saskatchewan, Canada.
body_markdown:
**Toronto, ON, November 10, 2026 – IsoEnergy Ltd. (“IsoEnergy”, or the “Company”) (NYSE American: ISOU; TSX: ISO)** is pleased to announce that it has agreed to acquire (the “ **Transaction** ”) 13,642,775 common shares (the “ **PUR Shares** ”) of Premier American Uranium Inc. (“ **PUR** ”) held by Sachem Cove Opportunity Fund LP (“ **Sachem Cove** ”) in consideration for the issuance of an aggregate of 387,491 common shares of the Company (the “ **ISO Shares** ”). The ISO Shares were issued at a deemed price of $11.763 per share, representing aggregate consideration of $4,558,057. Closing of the Transaction is subject to the satisfaction of certain customary closing conditions, including the approval of the Toronto Stock Exchange with respect to the issuance of the ISO Shares.


The Transaction will transfer Sachem Cove’s position in PUR to IsoEnergy, a founding and strategic shareholder, further strengthening IsoEnergy’s exposure to U.S. uranium development and in-situ recovery exploration. PUR will not issue any securities or receive any proceeds in connection with the Transaction. The increased investment follows PUR’s completion of a US$5 million strategic investment by DISA Uranium Corporation (“ **DISA Uranium** ”) in subscription receipts of PUR priced at C$0.75 each, representing a 41.5% premium to PUR’s closing share price on September 14, 2026, the last trading day before that investment was announced. The subscription receipts will convert into PUR Common Shares upon satisfaction or waiver of the applicable escrow release conditions. IsoEnergy is also a significant shareholder of DISA Uranium (see PUR press releases dated September 15, 2026, and November 10, 2026).


Philip Williams, CEO and Director of IsoEnergy, commented, “We are pleased to increase our position as a strategic shareholder of PUR as it advances the Cebolleta uranium project in New Mexico and pursues significant discovery potential through ongoing ISR exploration in Wyoming. We believe the recent weakness in PUR’s share price does not reflect the value of its development portfolio and exploration upside, creating an attractive opportunity to add to our holdings. This transaction further strengthens our exposure to the U.S. uranium sector which spans near-term production, development and exploration through our own portfolio and investments in DISA Uranium and PUR. DISA Uranium’s recent investment in PUR further reinforces the strategic support behind PUR as it pursues an exciting next phase of growth.”


Immediately prior to the completion of the Transaction, the Company owned an aggregate of 7,493,601 PUR Shares and warrants to acquire 3,060,127 PUR Shares, representing approximately 7.8% of the current outstanding PUR Shares on a non-diluted basis and approximately 10.7% of the current outstanding PUR Shares on a partially-diluted basis assuming exercise of all of the warrants held by the Company.


Assuming completion of the Transaction, the Company is deemed to own an aggregate of 21,136,376 PUR Shares and warrants to acquire an aggregate of 3,060,127 PUR Shares, representing approximately 22.1% of the current outstanding PUR Shares on a non-diluted basis and approximately 24.5% of the current outstanding PUR Shares on a partially-diluted basis assuming exercise of all of the warrants held by the Company.


The securities of PUR held by IsoEnergy are held for investment purposes. Although IsoEnergy has no current plans with respect to the securities, depending on market conditions, general economic and industry conditions, trading prices of PUR’s securities, PUR’s business, financial condition and prospects and/or other relevant factors, IsoEnergy may develop such plans or intentions in the future and, at such time, may from time to time acquire additional securities, dispose of some or all of the existing or additional securities or may continue to hold securities of PUR. The PUR Shares are being acquired by IsoEnergy pursuant to an exemption under Section 4.2 of National Instrument 62-104 – *Take-Over Bids and Special Transactions* .


This news release is issued pursuant to National Instrument 62-103 – *The Early Warning System and Related Take-Over Bid and Insider Reporting Issues* , which also requires an early warning report to be filed with the applicable securities regulators containing additional information with respect to the foregoing matters. A copy of the early warning report of IsoEnergy will be available under PUR’s profile on SEDAR+ at[www.sedarplus.ca](http://www.sedarplus.ca/) . IsoEnergy’s registered office is located at 217 Queen Street West, Toronto, ON M5V 0R2.


**About IsoEnergy Ltd.**


IsoEnergy (NYSE American: ISOU; TSX: ISO) is a leading, globally diversified uranium company with substantial current and historical mineral resources in top uranium mining jurisdictions of Canada, the U.S. and Australia at varying stages of development, providing near-, medium- and long-term leverage to rising uranium prices. IsoEnergy is currently advancing its Larocque East project in Canada’s Athabasca basin, which is home to the Hurricane deposit, boasting the world’s highest-grade indicated uranium mineral resource.
